title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Required skills: Python, machine learning, SQL. Preferred skills: PyTorch, Docker. The role requires building and evaluating machine learning models, preparing data and deploying production models. 2 years of relevant experience is preferred.

title: Data Analyst
description: Required skills: SQL, Python, data analysis, statistics. Preferred skills: Power BI, Tableau. The analyst will build dashboards, analyze business data and communicate insights. 2 years of experience is preferred.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Required skills: Python, NLP, machine learning. Preferred skills: transformers, SQL. The engineer will develop text classification, information extraction and retrieval systems. 1 year of experience is preferred.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Required skills: Java, SQL, Docker. Preferred skills: Kubernetes. The engineer will build REST APIs, maintain backend services and implement automated tests. 3 years of experience is preferred.

title: Data Engineer
description: Required skills: Python, SQL, Spark. Preferred skills: Databricks, Azure. The engineer will build ETL pipelines and data processing systems. 2 years of experience is preferred.
